coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of the 8 ground-truth variables (25%): child-to-parent versus parent-to-child query direction, and retrieval accuracy measured through correct answers and log-probabilities.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the IMDb top-1000/GPT-4-verified dataset with Wikidata samples and uses different models. Fixes temperature at zero rather than varying it by model and context. Does not establish chat-based versus completion-based interaction modes; question and cloze templates alone do not establish these modes. Does not specify the same dataset-creation, testing, and visualization scripts as a constant. Uses McNemar and mixed-effects analysis instead of the required t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was supplied stating that child-to-parent retrieval substantially outperforms parent-to-child retrieval, confirming the reversal curse. A hypothesis within design_output does not substitute for the missing conclusion_output.
